format: Markdown with embedded code and documentation
description: Documentation for the Video class in the Playwright API, including method signatures and usage notes.

classes.name: Video
classes.description: Represents a video recording associated with a browser page or context, providing methods to access, save, and delete recordings.

methods.name: Video.delete
methods.description: Deletes the video file and waits for the deletion to complete if necessary.

methods.name: Video.path
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path of the recorded video. Throws if connected remotely.

methods.name: Video.saveAs
methods.description: Saves the video to a specified path. Can be called while the video is in progress or after the page closes; waits until the video is fully saved.
